# Morphz Windows Sandbox

This private workspace crate builds the Windows-native sandbox helpers shipped
with Morphz. It is a branded, auditable derivative of OpenAI Codex's Windows
sandbox implementation; see `UPSTREAM.md`, `NOTICE`, and `LICENSE`.

The crate is not published independently. A supported Windows installation
ships `morphz.exe`, `morphz-edge.exe`, `morphz-windows-sandbox-runner.exe`,
`morphz-windows-command-runner.exe`, and
`morphz-windows-sandbox-setup.exe` as one versioned bundle.
